payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the rationale for using set expansion approaches in constructing dictionaries from customer reviews, particularly in enhancing understanding of natural language text and expanding entity sets with limited supervision.

claims.text: Entity set expansion (ESE) enhances a set of seed entities with new entities that belong to the same semantic concept, which is useful for understanding customer reviews.
ESE methods are particularly valuable in domains with scarce training data, allowing for the expansion of a small seed set with limited supervision.
The construction of dictionaries from customer reviews can benefit from ESE by identifying and verifying new characteristics in user-generated text.
